main_text.p: ac vere dixit Cicero: Nullum munus melius maiusúe Reipub. adferre possumus, quàm si doceamus & erudiamus Iuuentutem, ijs præsertim moribus & temporibus, quibus ipsa prolapsa est, vt omnium opibus refrenanda atque coërcenda sit: quantum Respub. Christiana Ludimagistris doctis, ad docendum aptis, laborum tollerantibus, disciplinæ amantibus, debeat, nón certè obscurum est.

Vt autem virtus & doctrina in obscuro esse nequeunt: & mediocres honores tempus auget; immodicos abolet, vt prudenter Theopompus Pylijs rescripsit: sic VVidebramus noster super pauca fidelis, super multa autem constituendus, diutius latere non potuit. Vocatus literis publicis Ienâ Thuringorum, in efflorescentem Academiam recens institutam, linguæ Latinæ Professorem egit ex Virgilio & Cæsare: ac Dialecticen, quæ est ὄργανον ὀργάνων & Philosophiæ manus fideliter exposuit: dignus profectò insigni elogio, quo vetustas Epicharmum olim suo merito commendauit:
Πολλὰ γὰρ ποτὲ ταῦ ξοὰμ τοῖς παισὶν εἶπε χρήσιμα· μεγάλα χάρις αὐτῷ.

Quòd autem in ea urbe, quidam ἑτεροδιδασκαλοῦντες, parum æqui essent, pridem piè defuncti Melanchthonis doctrinæ & consiliorum æstimatores: atque adeò ijs omnibus, qui hæc probantes, delectabantur memoria virtutum, doctrinæ, & meritorum in Rempub. Christianam tanti viri, infesti essent: factum est, vt humanissimis literis Doctoris Peuceri, doctissimi ac optimi quidam viri, VVitebergam accerserentur, ac eò quoque sese conferrent. page.notes: Greek lines are partly worn; the Greek in the first quotation and the word "ἑτεροδιδασκαλοῦντες" are uncertain and should be checked against the scan. The signature "D 2" is faint. The word "Respub." has a printed full stop before "Christiana", kept as printed.
